# Development agent campaign — 2026-11-23

<!-- Generated by tools/development_campaign.py; do not edit directly. -->

Requested: **100 actual worker assignments in five waves of 20**. Recorded: **43**. Completed: **40**.

Each wave runs in batches within the available concurrency. A later wave starts after all 20 reports in the preceding wave have been recorded. Completion records an assignment report, not resolved findings or physical fidelity.

This development campaign is separate from the [earlier setup campaign](CAMPAIGN.md). Recorded task names and report hashes provide an audit trail; the tool cannot independently attest agent execution.
